title: What's the deal with Vibe Toplist?
author: chelicerate-claws
selftext:
There aren't tons of AI-friendly places to share in-progress games, so I've looked through this sub a lot for suggestions.

I posted my game in the few places I could find, one of which is [Vibe Toplist](https://vibetoplist.com/), which exclusively features games with AI-generated code and/or assets. After a few days, I've gotten 30 "votes" on my game, escalating every day.

It looks like nearly every game - at least in the roguelike rankings where my game is - is escalating in votes at the same pace.

But my game's hosted on [itch.io](https://nanotyrannus.itch.io/lootmatch) and the analytics show that no one has ever landed on the game from Vibe Toplist. Anyone else had any odd experiences with this site?

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: It's most likely faked. I have two games on there. They move up about the same each month and my other sources never show vibetoplist as a referrer.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body: Are you paying vibe toplist? Otherwise you have your answer.

comments.author: itsnotcomplicated1
comments.body: They probably just want you to pay to get your game banner to appear at/near the top.

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body: Numbers are definitely fudged, nobody is visiting that site to look for games. It's just devs promoting to other devs. Not sure why anyone would pay for ad space.

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body:
Top game has 7000 people voting, 0 reviews. 

Fabricated community.
